module: Module 3: Fractional Lot Rounding & Remainder Allocation
title: Remainder Policy: Assign to Highest Equity Sub-Account
precondition: Remainder = 0.01 lot; Acc 1 has $10,050; Acc 2 has $10,000; Acc 3 has $9,950.
expected_result: Acc 1 receives 0.33 + 0.01 = 0.34 lots; Acc 2 receives 0.33 lots; Acc 3 receives 0.33 lots; total == 1.00 lot.
actual_result: Remainder of 0.01 routed to highest equity account (Acc1). Final lots: {'Acc1': 0.34, 'Acc2': 0.33, 'Acc3': 0.33}.
